hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "rm\s+-rf\s+(/|\./|\$HOME|~)" ; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive command on project root or home directory" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'osascript -e "display notification \"Claude is waiting for input\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null || notify-send "Claude Code" "Claude is waiting for input" 2>/dev/null || true'
